rows: Token and latency savings vs full JSON

Refined: the saving is a multi-event effect; 19–78% lower prefill and 4–36% faster decision at N = 10–50 vs compact text; replicated on a second sender. Against filtered text, single-request latency is similar; with batching the adapter has 10–30% higher throughput, 12–28% less energy per decision and a fixed memory footprint (Section 6.1); 4 tokens per event is the smallest reliable setting (Section 10.2)
